subject.title: fix: require env resolution for web provider refs

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's stricter handling of unresolved env-style web provider credential refs for web_search and web_fetch provider selection?
rationale: The patch is a narrow bug fix, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for configs that previously treated missing env-ref strings as truthy credentials.

options.title: Accept Stricter Env-Ref Semantics
options.body: Merge this behavior so env-style refs prove availability only through env resolution, using the PR body's live output and helper tests as the acceptance proof.

options.title: Ask For Caller-Level Proof
options.body: Require additional web_search and web_fetch runtime proof before merge if maintainers want stronger provider-selection upgrade confidence.

options.title: Pause For Compatibility
options.body: Hold the PR and choose a diagnostic-only or opt-in strict path if unresolved env-ref strings must keep selecting providers by default.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Env-Ref Semantics
recommendation.body: Merge this behavior so env-style refs prove availability only through env resolution, using the PR body's live output and helper tests as the acceptance proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant shared helper and web runtime selection refactor traces most clearly to steipete's merged history.
